tests: 9 combined tests passed, including session normalization, repeated subsequence compression, dominant path frequencies, static/dynamic alignment, malformed trace handling, and prior workflow/ML regressions

benchmark_outcomes.name: synthetic trace abstraction
benchmark_outcomes.details: Compression and aggregation operate in bounded linear passes over each session.

known_limitations: Trace abstraction summarizes observed sessions and preserves rare paths through frequency keys; it does not synthesize unobserved behavior.
schema_changes: Added session normalization, repetition compression, frequency, and alignment APIs.
